notes: The complete native XML and API values remain retained. The selected field map is an explicit reconciliation scope; unselected and unmapped source leaves are reported separately.

Simple protocol value lists are compared in original document order. Correlated protocol records and results collections require explicit recordLinks, preserving missing fields within their original rows.
Results collection fields require explicit source-record links; XML ID/IDREF values and public API group IDs have distinct scopes and are never presumed equal.
Public API Markdown and PRS text blocks retain exact strings; text formatting differences remain visible.
PRS internal provider_study_id and org_name have no equivalent public identity field. Explicit studyLinks bind the organization/protocol record to the captured NCT study.
XSD strings and source-comment numeric business fields are distinct. API integer numbers are parsed losslessly; malformed and empty numeric strings remain typed findings.
